chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washha, from Aban, from Zurara, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the waiting period of the woman who gives herself in divorce (Khul'a), how much is it? He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is the waiting period of the divorced woman (by Talaq), and let her observe it in her house; and the woman who divorces by mutual agreement (Mubarat) is in the same status as the woman who divorces by Khul'a.'

key_terms.الْمُبَارِئَة: The woman who divorces by mutual agreement (Mubarat)
key_terms.الْمُخْتَلِعَة: The woman who gives herself in divorce (Khul'a)
key_terms.الْمُطَلَّقَة: The woman divorced by husband's decree (Talaq)

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a woman divorced by Khul'a or Mubarat in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies that the 'Iddah for Khul'a and Mubarat mirrors that of Talaq, emphasizing the woman's residence in her marital home. This ruling underscores the jurisprudential principle that financial redemption or mutual agreement does not alter the fundamental waiting period structure, a key distinction in Shia fiqh regarding post-divorce obligations.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, from Aban, from Zurara who said,

‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about a waiting period of the woman divorced by Al-Khul’a, how much is it?’ Heasws said: ‘A waiting period of the divorced woman, and let her wait in her house; and a woman divorced by Al-Mubaraat is as the status of the woman divorced by Al-Khul’a’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ from Aban from Zurarah who has said the following:

“I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the waiting period of a woman in al-Khul‘. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is like the waiting period of a divorced woman and she must complete her waiting period in her home and a woman in al-Mubarat (disavowing) is the same as the one in al-Khul‘.’”
